title: Prussian school system designed for control

tellings.quote:
Because it was the Prussian miracle. So,
they sent people from all How did you
get such control over your citizens?

plain: The school system of Prussia, an old German kingdom, was built to control its people, and it worked so well that other countries sent visitors to learn how it was done. That is how a comedian named Kurt Metzger tells it, calling it "the Prussian miracle" and imagining the visitors asking, "How did you get such control over your citizens?" He offers it as a way of saying that modern schooling, including in the United States, was shaped for obedience more than learning.
